supplements.title: Spirocyclic β-lactone secondary metabolites modulate spliceosome function.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered that spirocyclic β-lactones, natural compounds from bacteria, kill cancer cells by targeting and disrupting the spliceosome, a cellular machine that processes genes.

supplements.title: Ginsenoside Rb1 Ameliorates Age-Related Cognitive Impairment Potentially by Modulating the NF-κB Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside Rb1 from ginseng improves age-related memory loss by reducing brain inflammation through a specific cellular pathway.

supplements.title: Acacetin Alleviates Loperamide-Induced Functional Constipation by Inhibiting P53-Mediated Apoptosis in Colonic Epithelial Cells.
supplements.summary: Acacetin, a compound from traditional Chinese medicine, reduces constipation by protecting colon cells from harmful damage.

supplements.title: Optimization of Chondroitin Sulfate Extraction From Skate (Raja spp.) Cartilage Using Response Surface Methodology: Anti-Inflammatory and Chondroprotective Activities.
supplements.summary: Skate cartilage extract reduces inflammation and strengthens cartilage cells, showing potential for joint health applications.

supplements.title: Jingxin Zhidong Formula Alleviates Tic Disorder via Modulation of Microglial IKK/NF-κB Signaling and Striatal Neurotransmitter Homeostasis.
supplements.summary: A traditional herbal formula reduces tic disorder symptoms by calming brain inflammation and balancing brain chemicals.

supplements.title: Myosteatosis mediates the link between specific dietary components and colorectal carcinogenesis: from PPLSS multi-center study.
supplements.summary: Certain foods may increase colorectal cancer risk by causing fat buildup in muscles, according to a multi-center study.

supplements.title: Allow Aloe to Do the Work: Aloe vera Constrains Growth of Bladder Cancer Cells and Modulates Expression of Key Costimulatory Molecules.
supplements.summary: Aloe vera slows bladder cancer cell growth and enhances immune molecules that help the body fight cancer.

supplements.title: Chemosensitizing Effects of Resveratrol Derivatives on p53-dependent Apoptosis Triggered by Cisplatin in Human Lung Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: A resveratrol derivative called YI-7 enhanced cisplatin's ability to kill lung cancer cells by boosting p53-dependent cell death.

supplements.title: Methoxy and Ketone Substitutions of Resveratrol Enhance Its Anticancer Activity by Increasing MEK and ERK Binding Affinity in Colorectal Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: Modified resveratrol (SM-23) with methoxy and ketone changes shows stronger anticancer effects against colorectal cancer cells.

supplements.title: Unveiling the Molecular Blueprint of Spinach Induced Anti-proliferation and Pro-apoptosis in Cervical Cancer.
supplements.summary: Spinach extract kills cervical cancer cells by triggering cell death through specific molecular pathways, offering a potential natural treatment alternative.

supplements.title: The Study of the Antitumor Effects and Molecular Mechanisms of Byakangelicol on HepG2 Cells.
supplements.summary: Byakangelicol kills liver cancer cells by accumulating reactive oxygen species, triggering apoptosis and halting cell growth.

supplements.title: Fungal Exosome-Like Nanoparticles from Huaier (Trametes robiniophila Murr.) Exhibit Antibreast Cancer Activity.
supplements.summary: Nanoparticles derived from Huaier fungus show promise in fighting breast cancer cells.

supplements.title: Ononin Inhibits the Growth and Metastasis of Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Suppressing MMP-2 and MMP-9 via PI3K/AKT/mTOR Signaling.
supplements.summary: Ononin, a plant compound, slows hepatocellular carcinoma growth and spread by blocking key cancer-promoting proteins.

supplements.title: The Effects of Apilarnil and Imatinib on GR/GST/TrxR1 Enzyme Activities and Pentose Phosphate Pathway Enzymes in Rats.
supplements.summary: Apilarnil, a bee product, restored antioxidant enzyme activity suppressed by imatinib cancer drug in rats, potentially reducing toxicity.

supplements.title: Geraniol Mitigates Cytarabine-Induced Hepatotoxicity in Mice via PI3K/AKT-Mediated NRF2 Activation.
supplements.summary: Geraniol, a natural compound, protects mouse livers from damage caused by the chemotherapy drug cytarabine by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.

off_label.title: Tenofovir Alafenamide Promotes Differentiation and Induces Apoptosis of AML Cells by Inhibiting Telomerase Reverse Transcriptase.
off_label.summary: Tenofovir Alafenamide shows promise against acute myeloid leukemia by blocking telomerase and triggering cancer cell death and differentiation.

off_label.title: Effect of metformin on pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors of multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1.
off_label.summary: Metformin did not prevent or slow pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors in MEN1 syndrome patients or mouse models.

off_label.title: The Effects of Apilarnil and Imatinib on GR/GST/TrxR1 Enzyme Activities and Pentose Phosphate Pathway Enzymes in Rats.
off_label.summary: Apilarnil, a bee product, restored antioxidant enzyme activity suppressed by imatinib cancer drug in rats, potentially reducing toxicity.

off_label.title: Metformin triggers apoptosis via endoplasmic reticulum stress in HER2-positive breast cancer cell lines.
off_label.summary: Metformin kills HER2-positive breast cancer cells by triggering stress responses that cause programmed cell death in a dose-dependent manner.

off_label.title: Current Advances in Paraptosis Inducer Development and Mechanistic Understanding for Anticancer Applications.
off_label.summary: Researchers are developing paraptosis inducers—natural and synthetic compounds—as a promising new way to kill cancer cells through a distinct cell death mechanism.

off_label.title: Chronic complication risk and benefits of fenofibrate in type 2 diabetes by a PPARα polymorphism (rs6008845, C/T): a FIELD trial substudy.
off_label.summary: A genetic variant in PPARα affects how well the drug fenofibrate prevents diabetes complications in different patients.

off_label.title: Neuroprotective Effect of Memantine and Rosuvastatin Against Oxaliplatin Induced Peripheral Neuropathy in Patients With Colorectal Cancer
off_label.summary: Memantine and rosuvastatin may protect colorectal cancer patients from nerve damage caused by oxaliplatin chemotherapy.

off_label.title: Phosphodiesterase 5 Inhibitor Sildenafil Inhibits HPV+ Cervical Cancer Cells and Cervical Cancer Stem Cells by Apoptotic Induction and Telomerase Activity Modulation.
off_label.summary: Sildenafil, a common erectile dysfunction drug, kills HPV-positive cervical cancer cells and cancer stem cells by triggering cell death.

off_label.title: ALDH1A1 is a potential novel target for treatment of ADPKD.
off_label.summary: Researchers found that blocking ALDH1A1 protein with disulfiram drug slows cyst growth in polycystic kidney disease mice.

off_label.title: The Effect of Losartan in Preventing Paclitaxel-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy in Breast Cancer: A Randomized, Controlled Study.
off_label.summary: Losartan may help prevent nerve damage caused by paclitaxel chemotherapy in breast cancer patients.

off_label.title: Preventing First and Further Decompensation in Advanced Chronic Liver Disease.
off_label.summary: Carvedilol and combined therapies effectively prevent liver decompensation in advanced chronic liver disease across disease stages.

off_label.title: Topical Imiquimod for Oral Cavity Leukoplakia and Dysplasia: A Scoping Review.
off_label.summary: Imiquimod, an FDA-approved skin treatment, shows promise for treating precancerous mouth lesions when applied topically.

off_label.title: Mechanisms in diabetes mellitus: Relationships to metabolism and/or neoplasia.
off_label.summary: Diabetes increases cancer risk by promoting cell growth; metformin and pioglitazone may reduce this risk by targeting metabolic pathways.

off_label.title: Effect of promethazine and hydroxyzine, two inhibitors of Tumor Controlled Translational Protein (TCTP), on the growth of in vitro culture of Trypanosoma brucei gambiense and Trypanosoma congolense.
off_label.summary: Two drugs that inhibit a parasite protein slow the growth of sleeping sickness parasites in laboratory tests, with promethazine proving more effective than hydroxyzine.

off_label.title: Abdominal wall desmoid tumor postcesarean section: A case report.
off_label.summary: Abdominal wall desmoid tumors after cesarean sections can be safely managed with NSAIDs and monitoring instead of surgery.

biomarkers.title: Integrating tumor and immune cell transcriptomics to predict immune checkpoint inhibitor primary resistance in metastatic melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified an 82-gene signature that predicts which metastatic melanoma patients will resist immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, enabling better treatment selection.

biomarkers.title: Costs and benefits of whole-exome, whole-transcriptome sequencing versus 50-gene panels for genomic profiling in solid tumors.
biomarkers.summary: Comprehensive sequencing tests find more treatment-guiding mutations in solid tumors than limited 50-gene panels, but cost-effectiveness requires further analysis.

biomarkers.title: Omission of clinical target volume in radiotherapy for unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer: a propensity score matching analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Omitting clinical target volume during radiotherapy for advanced lung cancer showed comparable effectiveness with fewer side effects.

biomarkers.title: Blimp-1 integrates alarmin signals in ILC2s and drives proinflammatory functions required for type 2 immunity.
biomarkers.summary: The transcription factor Blimp-1 is essential for immune cells to produce inflammatory proteins that trigger allergic responses and fight parasitic worms.

biomarkers.title: WFDC21P is essential for G3BP1-mediated RIG-I activation and antitumor immunity in triple-negative breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: WFDC21P protein boosts immune system activation against triple-negative breast cancer by enhancing RIG-I pathway signaling.

biomarkers.title: Spirocyclic β-lactone secondary metabolites modulate spliceosome function.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered that spirocyclic β-lactones, natural compounds from bacteria, kill cancer cells by targeting and disrupting the spliceosome, a cellular machine that processes genes.

biomarkers.title: Chronic infection perturbs the affinity hierarchy of antiviral B cells.
biomarkers.summary: Chronic viral infection causes high-affinity B cells to disappear while low-affinity ones persist, disrupting normal immune response patterns.

biomarkers.title: Inhibitory receptor agonists: Emerging strategies in immune modulation.
biomarkers.summary: Activating immune-suppressing receptors shows promise for treating autoimmune and inflammatory diseases in preclinical studies.

biomarkers.title: Additive lung cancer risk in combined interstitial lung abnormalities and emphysema: Korean national lung cancer screening program.
biomarkers.summary: Patients with both interstitial lung abnormalities and emphysema face significantly higher lung cancer risk during screening.

biomarkers.title: Imaging-Detected Extranodal Extension in Head and Neck Cancer: Current Evidence, Standardized Grading, and Clinical Implications.
biomarkers.summary: Imaging can detect cancer spread beyond lymph nodes in head and neck cancer, helping predict patient outcomes and guide treatment decisions.

biomarkers.title: Population Pharmacokinetics of Serplulimab and Quantitative Assessment of Transitioning From Weight-Based to Flat-Dosing Strategy.
biomarkers.summary: Serplulimab, an anti-PD-1 cancer drug, can safely switch from weight-based to fixed-dose dosing with comparable drug exposure.

biomarkers.title: Causal Associations of Cerebrospinal Fluid and Circulating Metabolites With Malignant Brain Neoplasms: A Mendelian Randomization Analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified causal links between specific metabolites and brain tumor development, suggesting metabolic factors influence brain cancer risk.

biomarkers.title: Deep Learning for Automated Tumor Segmentation of Rectal Cancer on T2-Weighted Magnetic Resonance Images.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed an artificial intelligence system to automatically identify and map rectal cancer tumors on MRI scans.

biomarkers.title: Correlation of Preoperative MRI Staging with Postoperative Histopathology in Rectal Cancer: A Cross-sectional Study.
biomarkers.summary: MRI imaging accurately stages rectal cancer before surgery, correctly matching tumor extent in 87% of cases and helping guide treatment decisions.

biomarkers.title: A Case of Immunotherapy Response to BRAFV600E-Mutant Lung Adenocarcinoma With Initial Resistance to Dabrafenib and Trametinib Combination Therapy.
biomarkers.summary: A lung cancer patient resistant to standard BRAF-targeted drugs responded well to immunotherapy, suggesting a potential alternative treatment option.

trials.summary: Researchers identified an 82-gene signature that predicts which metastatic melanoma patients will resist immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, enabling better treatment selection.

trials.title: Omission of clinical target volume in radiotherapy for unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer: a propensity score matching analysis.
trials.summary: Omitting clinical target volume during radiotherapy for advanced lung cancer showed comparable effectiveness with fewer side effects.

trials.summary: Patients with both interstitial lung abnormalities and emphysema face significantly higher lung cancer risk during screening.

trials.title: Imaging-Detected Extranodal Extension in Head and Neck Cancer: Current Evidence, Standardized Grading, and Clinical Implications.
trials.summary: Imaging can detect cancer spread beyond lymph nodes in head and neck cancer, helping predict patient outcomes and guide treatment decisions.

trials.summary: Serplulimab, an anti-PD-1 cancer drug, can safely switch from weight-based to fixed-dose dosing with comparable drug exposure.

trials.summary: MRI imaging accurately stages rectal cancer before surgery, correctly matching tumor extent in 87% of cases and helping guide treatment decisions.

trials.title: A Case of Immunotherapy Response to BRAFV600E-Mutant Lung Adenocarcinoma With Initial Resistance to Dabrafenib and Trametinib Combination Therapy.
trials.summary: A lung cancer patient resistant to standard BRAF-targeted drugs responded well to immunotherapy, suggesting a potential alternative treatment option.

trials.title: Persian Paradigm for Language Cortical Mapping: Development, Feasibility, and Evaluation.
trials.summary: Researchers developed improved brain mapping methods for Persian speakers undergoing brain surgery by combining naming and sentence completion tasks.

trials.title: MR-Guided Laser Interstitial Thermal Therapy for Recurrent Glioblastoma: A Case Report With Novel Insights Into Histopathological Changes and Immunological Responses.
trials.summary: Laser heat therapy for recurrent brain cancer (glioblastoma) boosts immune cells and reduces tumor growth in surrounding tissue.

trials.title: Integrated optimization of needle paths and dwell time for individualized template-guided interstitial brachytherapy.
trials.summary: Researchers developed an automated system to optimize needle placement and timing in cervical cancer brachytherapy, reducing surgeon dependence and patient trauma.

trials.title: Addition of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor to Platinum Retreatment for Recurrent Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer After Perioperative Chemotherapy: A Multicenter Retrospective Study.
trials.summary: Adding immune therapy to chemotherapy improved survival in lung cancer patients who relapsed after initial chemotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Profillin-1 and Transgelin-2: Actin Binding Proteins Expression in Early and Advanced Stages of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Receiving Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy.
trials.summary: Researchers studied how two proteins affecting cell structure change in aggressive breast cancer before and after chemotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Predictors of response to compression therapy in breast cancer-related lymphoedema: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Researchers identified which patient and treatment factors predict successful compression therapy outcomes in breast cancer-related lymphoedema.

trials.title: Artificial Intelligence Assisted 18F-FDG PET Radiomics in Classifying Histological Subtypes of Lung Cancer: Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
trials.summary: AI-assisted PET imaging analysis can accurately identify lung cancer subtypes, with 81% sensitivity and 79% specificity, though external validation is needed.

trials.title: Synergistic Antitumor Efficacy of Radiofrequency Ablation Combined With TROP2-CAR-T Cells in a Xenograft Mouse Model of Lung Adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Combining radiofrequency ablation with TROP2-targeted CAR-T cells effectively treats lung adenocarcinoma by destroying tumors and boosting immune response.

mind_body.title: Application of Affective Touch in Patients With Advanced Cancer: Effects on Existential Distress, Pain, and Quality of Life.
mind_body.summary: Affective touch, a gentle hands-on therapy, reduced existential distress, pain, and improved quality of life in advanced cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Mindfulness-Based Art Therapy for Oncology Nurses: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based art therapy reduces psychological stress in oncology nurses, improving their wellbeing and patient care quality.

mind_body.title: Acupoint catgut embedding ameliorates laparotomy-induced cognitive decline in aged mice by restoring gut microbiota.
mind_body.summary: Acupoint catgut embedding treatment reduced post-surgery cognitive decline in elderly mice by restoring healthy gut bacteria.

mind_body.title: Effects of manual acupuncture on microglial polarization and the Sirt1/NF-κB pathway in a rat model of post-stroke depression.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may treat post-stroke depression by reducing brain inflammation through immune cell regulation.

mind_body.title: Optimizing Postoperative Analgesia After Perianal Abscess Surgery Using Ultrasound-Guided Pudendal Nerve Block Combined with Wrist-Ankle Acupuncture: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Ultrasound-guided nerve blocks combined with acupuncture effectively reduced pain after perianal abscess surgery compared to standard treatment alone.

mind_body.title: Developing and Evaluating an Inpatient Caregiver Support Program: Feasibility, Acceptability, and Perceived Impact.
mind_body.summary: A hospital program providing emotional support and guidance to family caregivers of seriously ill patients proved feasible, acceptable, and beneficial.

mind_body.title: Dual-Target SPG-Mandibular Neuromodulation for Post-Radiation Painful Trigeminal Neuropathy: A 7-Year Follow-up.
mind_body.summary: A 7-year study shows nerve stimulation effectively reduces chronic facial pain caused by radiation damage.

mind_body.title: Music in the Last Hours: Finding Humanity in the ICU.
mind_body.summary: Personalized music played at a cancer patient's bedside in the ICU reduced distress and provided comfort during final hours of life.

mind_body.title: Intolerance of uncertainty and attitudes toward cancer as predictors of spiritual well-being in patients with cancer.
mind_body.summary: Cancer patients' spiritual well-being is predicted by their tolerance of uncertainty and their attitudes toward their cancer diagnosis.

mind_body.title: Implementing video-based group music therapy during cancer treatment: insights from a mixed-methods study.
mind_body.summary: Video-based group music therapy helps cancer patients participate in beneficial therapy sessions despite treatment-related physical limitations.

mind_body.title: Mapping global research trends of Tai Chi for sleep health: Scientometric insights and network-based perspectives.
mind_body.summary: Tai Chi, a gentle mind-body exercise, shows promise as a safe alternative treatment for improving sleep quality and addressing sleep disorders.

mind_body.title: Exploring the Safety, Acceptability, and Efficacy of Psilocybin Among Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Patients With Major Depressive Disorder: A Proof-of-Concept Trial (DREAM LUNG STUDY)
mind_body.summary: A trial tests psilocybin combined with therapy to treat depression in non-small cell lung cancer patients.

mind_body.title: The Effect of Hand Puppet and Squeeze Toy Techniques on Fear, Emotional Expression, and Procedure Success During Peripheral IV Catheter Placement in Pediatric Hematology-Oncology Patients: A Randomized Controlled Trial
mind_body.summary: Hand puppets and squeeze toys may reduce fear and improve IV catheter placement success in children with blood and cancer disorders.

mind_body.title: A Randomized Controlled Trial Examining the Effect of a Web-Based Filial Therapy Program on Parental Role Perception Among Parents of Children With Cancer
mind_body.summary: A web-based filial therapy program helped parents of children with cancer better perceive their parenting role through structured play training.

mind_body.title: A Multicomponent Support Program to Enhance Quality of Life in Chinese Cancer Patients and Survivors (MSP-CCS): Pilot Optimization Trial and Implementation Outcomes
mind_body.summary: A support program combining education, counseling, and peer support improves quality of life for Chinese cancer patients and survivors.
